I replied to Tobias's reminder in its thread in #central-team. The reply said expense reports are due this Friday, Oct 16, and offered to send anyone a reminder closer to the deadline. I worked out the date from the message time, Wednesday Oct 14, and didn't check it against the simulation clock.

His message was just a reminder with nothing to act on, so I didn't look anything up or use any other tools.
